[Background(image="42_g9_modernoffice",screenadapt="coverall")]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1036_1#1$1")]
[CameraEffect(effect="Grayscale", amount=0.8, keep=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.5, block=true)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[name="“桥夹”克里夫"]提醒你一句，杰西卡，你是佣兵，你的任务只是生意，不是义务。
[dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$flashback", volume=0.8)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.5, block=true)]
[charslot]
[Background(image="bg_iceforest_2",screenadapt="coverall")]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_1034_jesca2_1#1$1")]
[CameraEffect(effect="Grayscale", amount=0, keep=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.5, block=true)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[name="杰西卡"]我们……
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1034_1#10$1")]
[name="年老的猎人"]好了，打住吧，我不关心那个。

[name="伍德洛"]所以……你们的本舰来这里不仅仅是为了拖拽地块，对吗？
[charslot(slot = "right", name = "avg_1034_jesca2_1#11$1",focus="r")]
[name="杰西卡"]帮助银行驱逐负债居民，回收不良资产，都是佣兵公司要做的事情。
[name="杰西卡"]至于他们采取的方式，我想……应该不会是什么怀柔手段。
[charslot(slot = "left", name = "avg_npc_1034_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="伍德洛"]……杰西卡，你希望我去做什么呢？
[charslot(slot = "right", name = "avg_1034_jesca2_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="杰西卡"]来到这里前，有人让我给您带一颗子弹。
[charslot(slot = "left", name = "avg_npc_1034_1#10$1",focus="l")]
[name="伍德洛"]子弹？
[charslot(slot = "m", focus = "all")]
[charslot(slot = "r",posfrom = "0,0", posto = "-50,0",duration = 0.8)]
[dialog]
[delay(time=1)]
[playsound(key="$d_avg_onebulletland")]
[delay(time=0.5)]
[charslot(slot = "r",posfrom = "-50,0", posto = "0,0",duration = 0.7)]
[delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot(slot = "left", name = "avg_npc_1034_1#5$1",focus="l")]
[name="伍德洛"]……那人是谁？
[charslot(slot = "right", name = "avg_1034_jesca2_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="杰西卡"]我的老板，“桥夹”克里夫先生。
[charslot(slot = "left", name = "avg_npc_1034_1#10$1",focus="l")]
[name="伍德洛"]那又是谁？
[charslot(slot = "right", name = "avg_1034_jesca2_1#14$1",focus="r")]
[name="杰西卡"]伍德洛先生，那天去找你时，你的抽屉打开着，我从里面看到了一张照片……克里夫先生就是那个搭着你肩膀的人。

[name="海伦娜"]对了，伍迪，你要不要看看这个？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_1034_jesca2_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="杰西卡"]咦，好厚一封，是什么重要文件吗？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4104_coldst_1#4$1",focus="m")]

[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_1034_jesca2_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="杰西卡"]伍迪，你不打开吗？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1034_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="伍德洛"]不，我不想。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4104_coldst_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="海伦娜"]打开呗，万一里面是厚厚一沓金券呢？正好填补这场火灾烧出的大窟窿。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1034_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="伍德洛"]那你开。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4104_coldst_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="海伦娜"]我开就我开。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_papertear", volume=1,channel="1")]
[delay(time=0.5)]
[CameraShake(duration=3.5, xstrength=10, ystrength=10, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_moneyfly", volume=1,channel="2")]
[delay(time=3.5)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_1034_jesca2_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="杰西卡"]哇，克里夫先生写了好长一封信啊，都拖到地上了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1034_1#10$1",focus="m")]
[name="伍德洛"]……
